defs.def: gone by in time 过去的；昔日的

ex.s: But for all its ancient buildings, Beijing is also a place ____43____ welcomes the fast-paced development of modern life, with 21st-century architectural ____44____ (wonder) standing side by side with historical buildings of the past.
ex.t: 但尽管有许多古建筑，北京也是一个____43____欢迎现代生活快节奏发展的地方，21世纪的建筑____44____（wonder）与过去的历史建筑比邻而立。

ex.s: Her miserable past.
ex.t: 完成UCLA的注册程序

ex.s: The problems at present are similar to those in the past.
ex.t: 现在的问题与过去的问题相似。

ex.s: Present past academic records to UCLA.
ex.t: 向加州大学洛杉矶分校提交过去的学业成绩。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: For the past ten years, my dad and I have attended the same school — he as an administrator and I as a student.
ex.t: 在过去的十年里,我和我爸爸在同一所学校上学——他是一个行政人员,我是一个学生。

ex.s: For the past five years, Paula Smith, a historian of science, has devoted herself to re-creating long-forgotten techniques.
ex.t: 在过去的五年里，科学史家 Paula Smith 一直致力于重现早已被遗忘的技术。

ex.s: Past People lost track of their friends after 1_________.
ex.t: 过去的人在1 _________后失去了朋友的踪迹。

ex.s: “Be yourself.” For the past 20 years.
ex.t: “做你自己。”在过去的20年里。

ex.s: This nature of data makes the antitrust measures of the past less useful.
ex.t: 数据的这一性质使得过去的反垄断措施不太有效。

defs.def: gone by recently; just ended 刚过去的；刚结束的
belonging to an earlier time 从前的；以往的
connected with the form of a verb used to express actions in the past （动词）过去式的

ex.s: Smart recommendation engines analyze data such as exhibit popularity and visitors’ past behavior to suggest specific exhibits and events, making each visit unique and surprising. _____37_____ These digital assistants engage visitors in dynamic conversations and offer context-sensitive insights that deepen understanding and satisfy curiosity.
ex.t: 智能推荐引擎会分析展品受欢迎程度和参观者过往行为等数据，推荐特定的展品和活动，让每次参观都独一无二、充满惊喜。_____37_____ 这些数字助手与参观者进行动态对话，并提供契合情境的解说，加深理解、满足好奇心。

ex.s: Zafirakou began the project at Alperton Community School, her place of work for the past twelve years.
ex.t: 扎菲拉库在阿尔珀顿社区学校启动了这个项目，那是她过去十二年工作的地方。

ex.s: When I finally started to study, I would race through the assigned work, often well past midnight.
ex.t: 等我终于开始学习时，我会匆匆忙忙赶完布置的作业，常常早已过了午夜。

ex.s: I get up at half past seven.
ex.t: 我七点半起床。

defs.def: the time that has gone by; things that happened in an earlier time 过去；昔日；过去的事情

ex.s: Discover the China of“past ages，its walled cities，temples and mountain scenery with Prof  Robert Thorp.
ex.t: 与Robert Thorp教授一起发现"过去时代"的中国，它的城墙环绕的城市、寺庙和山地风光。

ex.s: As my eyes rested on them, I felt as though I were looking through a window into my own past.
ex.t: 当我的目光停留在它们身上时，我觉得仿佛透过一扇窗看到了自己的过去。

ex.s: We don't have to live in the past, but we can definitely do better by learning from it and using the lessons learnt to lead more meaningful lives.
ex.t: 我们不必生活在过去，但我们可以通过从中学习并运用学到的教训来过上更有意义的生活，从而做得更好。

ex.s: Know the Past, Know the Present
ex.t: 了解过去，了解现在

ex.s: People live longer than they did in the past.
ex.t: 人们比过去活得更久了。

ex.s: In the past, there was often an automatic reaction to increased traffic: just widen the roads, says Mark Poch, the Bellevue Transportation Department’s traffic engineering manager.
ex.t: 过去,交通量增加时经常出现自动反应:贝勒维尤交通局交通工程经理马克·波奇(Mark Poch)说,只要拓宽道路就行了。

ex.s: In the past year, Detrinidad sent out more than 70,000 plants.
ex.t: 在过去一年中，德特里尼达德送出了超过70,000株植物。

ex.s: The ____49____ (remark) development of this city, which is consciously designed to protect the past while stepping into the modern world, _____50_____ (mean) there is always something new to discover here, and I could be photographing Beijing for the next 50 years.
ex.t: 这座城市____49____（remark）非凡的发展——有意识地设计为在迈向现代世界的同时保护过去——_____50_____（mean）意味着这里总有新东西等待发现，我可以在未来50年里一直拍摄北京。

ex.s: Habitat loss, pesticide use, and climate change have caused dramatic declines in pollinator populations over the past couple of decades, which has damaged the US agricultural economy.
ex.t: 栖息地的丧失、杀虫剂的使用和气候变化在过去几十年中导致传粉昆虫数量急剧下降，这损害了美国农业经济。

ex.s: Over the past few years, many solar farm developers have transformed the space under their solar panels into a shelter for various kinds of pollinators, resulting in soil improvement and carbon reduction.
ex.t: 过去几年里，许多太阳能农场开发商把太阳能板下的空间改造成了各种传粉昆虫的庇护所，从而改善了土壤并减少了碳排放。

ex.s: Human impact on the animal kingdom, such as hunting and destruction of habitats, ___________a reduction in the population of certain species in the past three decades.
ex.t: 人类对动物王国的影响，如狩猎和栖息地破坏，________导致过去三十年某些物种种群数量的减少。

ex.s: Herman Cruse, a school bus driver from New Jersey, has been with Middle Township Public Schools for the past nine years.
ex.t: 赫尔曼·克鲁斯是新泽西州一名校车司机，过去九年在Middle Township公立学校工作。

ex.s: For the past three summers, I have worked in a government agency in New York.
ex.t: 在过去三个夏天里，我在纽约的一个政府机构工作过。

ex.s: In the past ten years, one percent of our company’s profits ____ given to local charities.
ex.t: 在过去十年中，我们公司百分之一的利润____捐给了当地慈善机构。

ex.s: Mr Titterton is chairman of the Omega Ensemble but has been the group’s official page turner for the past four years.
ex.t: 蒂特顿先生是Omega乐团的主席，但在过去四年里他一直是该乐团的官方翻谱员。

ex.s: In the past few years, an increasing number of people and organisations have begun coming up with plans to counter this trend.
ex.t: 过去几年里，越来越多的人和组织开始提出计划来遏制这一趋势。

ex.s: There ____17____(be) a dramatic rise in the number of extreme weather events over the past 20 years,____18____(cause) largely by rising global temperatures,according to a new report from the United Nations.
ex.t: 根据联合国的一份新报告，过去20年里极端天气事件的数量___17___（be）急剧上升，这主要由全球气温升高___18___（cause）。

ex.s: A retired engineer, 76-year-old Wilson has been   11   free rides to college students for the past eight years.
ex.t: 76岁的退休工程师威尔逊，过去八年一直在给大学生___11___免费搭载。

ex.s: While the decline over the past decade is steep for teen readers, some data in the report shows that reading remains a big part of many children’s lives, and indicates how parents might help encourage more reading.
ex.t: 虽然过去十年青少年读者的下降幅度很大，但报告中的一些数据显示阅读仍然是许多儿童生活中的重要部分，并表明家长可能如何帮助鼓励更多阅读。

ex.s: Corn production has jumped nearly 125 percent over   62   past 25 years, while rice has increased only 7 percent.
ex.t: 玉米产量在____62____过去25年里增长了近125%，而水稻只增长了7%。

ex.s: China’s high-speed railways _________ from 9,000 to 25,000 kilometers in the past few years.
ex.t: 中国的高铁里程在过去几年里从9,000公里增长到25,000公里。

ex.s: I had grown not only physically, and also mentally in the past few years.
ex.t: 过去几年里，我不仅身体成长了，心智也成熟了。

ex.s: But during the past decade declining rainfall has allowed him to plant highly profitable crops.
ex.t: 但在过去十年里，降雨量的减少使他能够种植高利润的作物。

ex.s: Tobacco was used as coins or paper bills in American in the past.
ex.t: 过去在美国，烟草曾被当作硬币或纸币使用。

ex.s: He discovered that whether someone describes having had some control over events in their past is an important predictor of a person’s mental health.
ex.t: 他发现，一个人是否描述自己过去对事件有过某种掌控感，是预测其心理健康的重要指标。

ex.s: I realized that we have to learn to leave the past behind.
ex.t: 我意识到我们必须学会把过去抛在身后。

ex.s: letting go of the past
ex.t: 放下过去

ex.s: According to the experts, problems faced by people regardless of the past and present are the same.
ex.t: 根据专家的说法，人们无论在过去还是现在所面临的问题都是一样的。

ex.s: A Past Present Future B Past Present Future C Past Present Future D Past Present Future E Past Present Future Dad: Adam, Sally, come here.
ex.t: A过去现在未来B过去现在未来C过去现在未来D过去现在未来E过去现在未来爸爸：亚当，莎莉，过来。

ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 这项由哥伦比亚气候学院及其他机构的科学家开展的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中沿用过去的树种模式，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平最多将上升30%。

ex.s: Past research has found health and wellness benefits of nature for humans, but a new study shows that wildness in urban areas is extremely important for human well-being.
ex.t: 过去的研究发现了大自然对人类健康和幸福的益处，而一项新研究表明，城市中的自然野趣对人类的幸福极其重要。

ex.s: How past events should be presented.
ex.t: 过去的事件应该如何呈现。

ex.s: William Hastie once suggested that history informs us of past mistakes                   we can learn without repeating them.
ex.t: 威廉·哈斯蒂曾经建议历史告诉我们过去的错误                   我们可以从中学习而不必重蹈覆辙。

ex.s: The Caribbean Taino, the Australian Aboriginals, the African people of Benin and the Incas, all of whom appear in this book, can speak to us now of their past achievements most powerfully through the objects they made: a history told through things gives them back a voice.
ex.t: 加勒比地区的泰诺人、澳大利亚原住民、贝宁的非洲人和印加人——他们都出现在这本书中——如今可以通过他们制作的物件最有力地对我们讲述他们过去的成就：通过物讲述的历史让他们重获声音。

ex.s: They think tradition means old things from the past.
ex.t: 他们认为传统意味着过去的老东西。

ex.s: Talking about food encouraged her parents to finally open up about their past, like the fact that her father had owned a Chinatown restaurant in the 1940s.
ex.t: 谈论食物促使她的父母终于敞开心扉谈起了他们的过去，比如她父亲在1940年代曾拥有一家唐人街餐馆。

ex.s: Shirley Fitzgerald, the city’s official historian, told me that in its rush to modernity in the 1970s, Sydney swept aside much of its past, including many of its finest buildings.
ex.t: 悉尼官方历史学家Shirley Fitzgerald告诉我，在20世纪70年代急于现代化的过程中，悉尼抛弃了过去的很多东西，包括许多精美的建筑。

ex.s: In the past few years, online learning has become a significant part of the university and college experience.
ex.t: 在过去几年里，在线学习已成为大学和学院学习体验的重要组成部分。

ex.s: turn to her old friends             D. speak out about her past
ex.t: 求助于她的老朋友             D. 说出她的过去

ex.s: S. who have a driver's license, who have tried alcohol, who date, and who work for pay has plummeted since 1976, with the most precipitous ___43___ in the past decade.
ex.t: 自1976年以来，拥有驾照、尝试过酒精、约过会、有偿工作的美国青少年比例急剧下降，过去十年的降幅最为明显。

defs.def: a person's past life or career （某人）过去的经历（或事业）

ex.s: My husband, our children and I have had wonderful camping experiences over the past ten years.
ex.t: 我的丈夫、我们的孩子和我过去十年中有过美好的露营经历。

ex.s: We could rephrase it like this: understand the wisdom in past decisions before you reject them.
ex.t: 但对"既有做法"不加批判的盲目遵从也可能使我们失去拥有更好日子的可能性。

ex.s: Reform should draw from the wellspring of past wisdom.
ex.t: 改革应从过往智慧的源泉中汲取养分。

ex.s: Past experiences should be treasured.
ex.t: 过去的经历应该珍惜。

defs.def: later than sth 晚于；在 … 之后

ex.s: In the past, sound engineers worked in the back rooms of recording studios, but many of today's sound professionals are sharing their knowledge and experience with professionals in other fields to create new products based on the phenomenon we call sound.
ex.t: 对于那些对声音感兴趣的人来说，声音技术领域确实正在引起轰动。

ex.s: In the past, money's makeup varied from place to place, depending on what was considered valuable there.
ex.t: 在西非，青铜或铜手镯被用作现金，特别是如果交易与那里的奴隶贸易有关的话。

ex.s: Especially glbalisation and better communications in the past few decades, all have caused many Languages to disappear, and dominant languages such as English.
ex.t: 尤其是近几十年的全球化和更好的通讯方式，都导致许多语言消失，而英语等主导语言正在日益占据主导地位。

ex.s: I've traveled back several times since, most recently this past spring.
ex.t: 从那以后我又回去过几次，最近一次是在今年春天。

ex.s: I parked my car outside the farm and walked past a milking house which had apparently not been used in many years.
ex.t: 我把车停在农场外，走过一间显然多年未用的挤奶房。

ex.s: Understanding history is vital to understanding ourselves as a people and as a nation． History is much more than the study of dusty old objects and events long past． It is an essential part of who we are today and who we will become． Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition makes understanding history exciting， engaging， and fun!
ex.t: 理解历史对理解我们作为一个民族、一个国家的自我至关重要。历史远不止是对尘封旧物与久远事件的研究。它是我们今天之所是、未来之将是的本质部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛让理解历史变得激动人心、引人入胜且充满乐趣！

ex.s: It is in a location 1__________ we can watch animals wandering past on their way to the waterhole.
ex.t: 房源位于1 __________ ，我们可以看到动物在前往水坑的路上徘徊。

defs.def: on or to the other side of sb/sth 在另一边；到另一侧

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.
ex.t: 话虽如此，随着发令枪响，我会全力扎进冷水中，尽可能快地游向泳池另一边，却发现其他游泳者从我身边滑过。

defs.def: above or further than a particular point or stage 多于；超过
from one side of sth to the other 从一侧到另一侧；经过

ex.s: Farber is certain that the holistic approach will grow more popular with time, and if the past is any indication, he may be right: Since 1982, membership in the American Holistic Veterinary Medical Association has grown from 30 to over 700.
ex.t: 法伯确信整体疗法会随时间越来越受欢迎，如果过去可以作为参照的话，他可能是对的：自1982年以来，美国整体兽医学协会的会员已从30人增加到700多人。
